core_concepts: About the Author STEVE MAGNESS is a world-renowned expert on performance, coauthor of Peak Performance and The Passion Paradox, and the author of The Science of Running
Discover great authors, exclusive offers, and more at hc.com
He is the cofounder of The Growth Equation
His writing has appeared in Runner’s World and Sports Illustrated, and he has been featured in The New Yorker, The Wall Street Journal, the New York Times, and others
As a performance coach, Magness works with executives, entrepreneurs, and athletes
